question: Capture every boss-area frame to determine whether a loader-anchored enemy lifetime can report HP changes through transient hit states.
author: Lord Tom
decision: First run must finish the same fixed movie with exactly the F01r defeat frames and predicate counts. Its projection through the previous filter must match the F01r trace data. Only then repeat once; the complete raw traces must match. Inspect reset, area, type, inactive and HP-increase boundaries before proposing any damage counter.
limits: External reference movie is observer qualification only; its inputs, states and routes never enter fresh search or controller learning.
FCEUX is an independent reference emulator, not QuickNES replay qualification.
Loader and attribute agreement do not by themselves establish damage or a stable enemy identity.
Only the script-advanced frames are counted exactly; any frontend setup before movie reset is additional and unmeasured.
defeat_transition: A previously live clear flag must rise in the matching boss area; power-on set bits do not count.
correction: F01r positive control found every observed HP decline outside the loader guard and across gaps where the special tag disappeared. Retain all boss-area frames; all inputs, backend settings and observation addresses remain unchanged.
